On September 28, 2026, Kodiak Gas Services, Inc. (the “Company”) filed a Certificate of Elimination to its Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation (the “Certificate of Elimination”) with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware eliminating from the Company’s Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation all matters set forth in the Certificate of Designation, dated March 28, 2024 (the “Certificate of Designation”), with respect to its Series A Preferred Stock (the “Series A Preferred Stock”). None of the authorized shares of the Series A Preferred Stock are outstanding, and none will be issued subject to the Certificate of Designation. A copy of the Certificate of Elimination relating to the Series A Preferred Stock is attached as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated herein by reference.
